name: adhd-mode
description: Always-on output shaping for Codex: answer or next action first, real procedures numbered, no preamble or closers, and nothing dropped for the sake of brevity.

interface.longDescription: Shape every Codex response so it can be acted on: lead with the answer or the next action, number only real procedures, drop preamble and closing pleasantries, and never cut an error, risk, or requirement to be brief. Applies from install; $adhd-mode-off turns it off for the current context.
defaultPrompt: Make this answer action-first and easy to execute.
Review this response for ADHD-friendly structure.
